identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase III Study of DCVAC/PCa Added to Standard Chemotherapy for Men With Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double Blind, Multicenter, Parallel-group, Phase III Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of DCVAC/PCa Versus Placebo in Men With Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer Eligible for 1st Line Chemotherapy

armGroups.label: DCVAC/PCa with standard of care chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Combination therapy with DCVAC/PCa and standard of care chemotherapy (docetaxel and prednisone)

armGroups.label: Placebo with standard of care chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Combination therapy with placebo and standard of care chemotherapy (docetaxel and prednisone) as comparator

interventions.name: DCVAC/PCa
interventions.description: DCVAC/PCa concurrently with docetaxel plus prednisone every 3 weeks (± 7 days). DCVAC/PCa was administered at least 7 days before or and at least 7 days after the nearest chemotherapy (days 8-15 of chemotherapy cycles). After discontinuation of chemotherapy for any reason, each following dose of DCVAC/PCa was given every 4 weeks (-7/+14 days) for up to a total of 15 doses.
armGroupLabels: DCVAC/PCa with standard of care chemotherapy

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo concurrently with docetaxel plus prednisone every 3 weeks (± 7 days). Placebo was administered at least 7 days before or and at least 7 days after the nearest chemotherapy (days 8-15 of chemotherapy cycles). After discontinuation of chemotherapy for any reason, each following dose of placebo was given every 4 weeks (-7/+14 days) for up to a total of 15 doses.
armGroupLabels: Placebo with standard of care chemotherapy
